description: This file implements the GstWrapper class and related factory functions for creating and managing GStreamer objects, including setting caps and structures. It also includes factory singleton management and logging for error handling.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with GStreamer structures and caps.

classes.name: IGstWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of GstWrapper and related objects.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of IGstWrapperFactory, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGstWrapper
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of IGstWrapper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets simple key-value pairs on GstCaps object using variable arguments.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and initial field.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets fields on a GstStructure object using variable arguments.
